anchors.paper_title: A Human Motor Imagery EEG Dataset Covering Diverse Cognitive States and Neural Response Patterns
anchors.paper_venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
anchors.reason: The Zenodo record is the IMU-MI_A dataset (same DOI as the dataset's source and same authors), describing multi-paradigm motor imagery EEG, so it is the original deposit of this data.

anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used to format the dataset, not a paper describing this motor-imagery dataset.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard extension (BIDS for EEG) used to format this dataset, not a paper describing the IMUMIA2026 motor-imagery data.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps amplifier and a 64-channel Quik-Cap (Ag/AgCl passive electrodes, Cz reference, forehead ground, impedance below 10 kOhm) at 1000 Hz. EOG, ECG and EMG channels were also recorded. Each participant completed one session of five runs, one motor-imagery task per run, using visually cued arrow trials with 4 s imagery periods.
